verdict.rationale: Edge0 documents its own offload mechanism for running models larger than available memory: expert weights stream from SSD on demand, so peak memory is bounded by the active set (35B MoE in ~2.5 GB). A trained prerouter overlaps those loads with the forward pass for up to +59% decode throughput. However, this is SSD-to-memory expert streaming rather than the CPU+GPU split the story names, and the CUDA backend is only a reserved slot. missing for 10: documented CPU+GPU layer/tensor split offload, user-configurable GPU layer allocation, discrete-GPU (CUDA) support, independent or hands-on corroboration of larger-than-VRAM runs.
